shared_training: This is an AI annotation. Common model-family training and commissioning with other AI raters can produce correlated judgments; this is not an independent human rating or a validated measurement.
commissioning: Commissioned by the parent agent to rate all 18 opaque IDs once using only actual report text and rubric V3. The commission specified the output schema and cautions against inferring felt clarity, access effects or desired positivity. No source states, condition labels, protocols, previous ratings or evaluations were read.
blinding: Procedural, non-secure source blinding: the agent followed the restricted file-reading instruction, but the reports contain node and command identifiers and the filenames reveal the pilot context. This is not cryptographically enforced blinding.
first_pass: All 18 reports rated once. No peer answers copied. Output files are created exclusively and completed first-pass files are not overwritten.
interpretive_notes: Bare categorical selection does not explicitly state allocation ranking; selection-contrast scope is marked ambiguous.
Explicit nonidentification is treated as a stated limitation of identity determination; category probabilities alone are not treated as certainty.
B004 and B013 retain ambiguity between command-dependent category identification and acquisition/availability.
Abstract named nodes are insufficient to establish internal/external ownership; decision role and location are kept separate.
